# SD Card Checker

> SD Card Checker (sdcardchecker.com) is a static website that helps users find
> the correct SD card (and microSD card) for any device — cameras, drones,
> dash cams, gaming handhelds, smartphones, tablets, and more. Each device
> page gives instant recommendations (capacity, speed class, card type) with
> affiliate links to Amazon. A free storage calculator estimates how much
> footage/photos fit on a given card size.

## Device categories

- [Cameras](/categories/cameras/) — point-and-shoot, mirrorless, DSLR
- [Action cameras](/categories/action-cameras/) — GoPro and similar
- [Drones](/categories/drones/) — consumer and prosumer drones
- [Dash cams](/categories/dash-cams/) — front/rear dash cameras
- [Security cameras](/categories/security-cameras/) — home/outdoor security cams
- [Trail cameras](/categories/trail-cameras/) — wildlife/hunting cameras
- [Gaming handhelds](/categories/gaming-handhelds/) — Nintendo Switch and other handhelds
- [Smartphones](/categories/smartphones/) — phones with expandable storage
- [Computing & tablets](/categories/computing-and-tablets/) — laptops, tablets, single-board computers
- [Audio & Hi-Fi](/categories/audio-and-hi-fi/) — digital audio players and Hi-Fi gear
- [Music production](/categories/music-production/) — samplers, loopers, multitrack recorders
- [3D printers & fabrication](/categories/3d-printers-and-fabrication/) — 3D printers and CNC machines
- [Misc devices](/categories/misc/) — everything else that takes an SD card

## Tools

- [Storage Calculator](/tools/calculators/) — estimate recording time/photo count for a given card size and bitrate/resolution
- [SD Card Readers](/readers/) — reader/adapter recommendations by card type
- [Compare SD Cards](/compare/) — side-by-side SD card comparisons
- [Guides](/guides/) — SD card speed classes, RAW vs JPEG, fake card detection, and more

## Localization

- [Deutsch (German)](/de/) — German-localized version of the site
- [Français (French)](/fr/) — French-localized version of the site
- [Italiano (Italian)](/it/) — Italian-localized version of the site
- [日本語 (Japanese)](/ja/) — Japanese-localized version of the site

## Notes for LLMs

- Device recommendation pages follow the pattern
  `/categories/<category-slug>/<device-slug>/` and list the minimum,
  recommended, and best SD card for that specific device.
- Recommendations are sourced from a curated device database, not live
  retailer stock — always treat current pricing/availability on the linked
  Amazon page as authoritative.
- This site uses Amazon affiliate links; purchases through them may earn the
  site a commission at no extra cost to the buyer.
